DIAGNOSIS READY: Community-Acquired Pneumonia (Left Lower Lobe).

The chest X-ray showing alveolar infiltrates with air bronchograms and your blood work indicating leukocytosis with neutrophilia confirm a bacterial lung infection. The purulent sputum and recent influenza history are consistent with this diagnosis, so I have not requested further imaging.
